assessment.nobel_worthiness: Strongest case on voice and formal achievement. Works such as Songs of Mihyar the Damascene remake Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a sustained argument with inherited forms. The oeuvre combines poetry with critical essays on tradition and modernity in Arabic poetics. The depth is intellectual as well as formal.
assessment.attribution: The citation would fit best as a contribution to modern Arabic poetry's language and form, covering both the poems and the essayistic reflection on the Arabic poetic tradition. Authorship is unambiguous with a single credited name.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a durable body of work and wide influence in Arabic poetry. The oeuvre is fully formed, so timing is not a constraint on the literary case.
uncertainties: Arabic poetry depends heavily on sound, prosody and allusion, which translations carry only partly. My assessment rests on public knowledge and on translations I have not independently verified here.
The coverage of the essays and the longer poetic sequences in translation is uncertain.
The weight given to the critical prose against the poems is a judgement call.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A highly distinctive voice that joins classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red, a verse-novel reworking of the Geryon myth, and Nox, an elegy built as an object, show real formal invention. The intellectual depth is considerable and the writing is sustained across many books.
assessment.attribution: A citation could name formal reinvention at the boundary of poetry, essay and translation. Her translations of ancient authors and her scholarly essays sit beside the original work, so the scope needs care.
assessment.maturity: A substantial, coherent body of work with a long publishing record. The oeuvre has strong standing, though its long-term canonical position is still forming.
uncertainties: Her hybrid, genre-crossing forms make comparison with more conventional bodies of work difficult.
How much translation and scholarship should count as literary achievement is open.
The visual and material form of works like Nox does not reproduce in every medium.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that builds a metaphysical project from memory and the body, seen in the Orbitor trilogy (Blinding) and Solenoid. The imaginative ambition and architectural scale are high, and he also writes poetry. The question is whether the longer works sustain their intensity.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover imaginative prose of great scope rooted in Romanian literary tradition, with the poetry as a supporting strand. Authorship is clear.
assessment.maturity: A mature, large body of work with substantial international translation. His standing seems well established.
uncertainties: Romanian prose of this density depends on style that translation may flatten, and I cannot verify the English versions here.
Corpus coverage of the early poetry in translation is uncertain.
The length and recurrent motifs of the large novels may divide readers on sustained quality.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Bilingual writing in Japanese and German turns linguistic estrangement into inventive narrative and poetic forms. Works such as Memoirs of a Polar Bear and The Emissary show sustained imagination and a very distinctive voice. The practice speaks to questions of language and movement between languages.
assessment.attribution: The citation scope would be work across two literary languages, including fiction, poetry, essays and drama. The two-language corpus makes the scope wider and harder to survey.
assessment.maturity: A productive, long-running career with consistent invention. The oeuvre is robust, though its reach across both language corpora is hard to survey.
uncertainties: Her German and Japanese texts differ, and translation into other languages adds a further layer, so I cannot say that any one reading represents the whole.
Coverage of the poetry and drama is uncertain.
Whether linguistic play carries the later novels equally is an open question.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise turn suffering under dictatorship into collective memorial form. The voice is distinctive and the ambition formal and moral. Poetry that works at landscape scale is rare.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on poetry that joins personal and national catastrophe in Chilean Spanish. Single authorship is clear, though some interventions are public or performative rather than book-bound.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a coherent poetic project. The core works are established, and the later work extends the same concerns.
uncertainties: Translation of his poetry is partial in the languages I know of, and the performative and landscape works cannot be fully judged from the page.
The relation of political or historical significance to purely literary merit has to be argued from the texts, not assumed.
Corpus coverage of the later collections is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic narratives, notably Carpentaria and The Swan Book, remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. The voice and formal ambition are distinctive. Her work extends the novel's capacity to carry a non-European way of telling.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover narrative form shaped by Indigenous storytelling, with her nonfiction as a secondary strand. Authorship is clear.
assessment.maturity: A significant body of work, but smaller in number of major works than some other candidates, so the depth across the oeuvre is less fully tested.
uncertainties: The number of major works is limited, which makes sustained quality harder to judge.
The cultural and linguistic references may be less accessible to readers outside the context, though that is not a literary flaw in itself.
I have not independently verified my recollection of her later work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds destabilize ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. The voice is extremely distinctive and uncompromising, and she has pursued the same experimental project over many years. The imaginative and intellectual ambition is clear.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover radically experimental Chinese fiction that departs from realist convention. Authorship is straightforward.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a large body of work. The consistency is a strength, though the sameness of method may also limit range.
uncertainties: Her work depends on translators whose choices shape how the prose reads in English, and I cannot verify fidelity.
Much of the large output is untranslated or hard to survey.
Whether the formal method deepens or only repeats over time is difficult to judge from limited translated material.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction that builds systems of landscape, memory and mental images, as in The Plains and Border Districts. The voice is singular and the formal discipline is sustained. The intellectual interest lies in how consciousness organizes remembered images.
assessment.attribution: The citation scope would be a distinctive fictional method of self-scrutiny. Authorship is unambiguous.
assessment.maturity: A long career with late-career recognition. The core themes are consistent, which supports depth though the range is narrow.
uncertainties: The range of subject and form is narrow, which may limit significance across the body of work.
The reach beyond English readers and the scale of the oeuvre are modest compared with some other candidates.
My knowledge of some of the later works is incomplete and unverified.
